title: Uplift Added to an Air Ticket Fare Brands Voucher for a Wanderlane Traveller Club Membership
content:
A traveller's standing in the Wanderlane Traveller Club may add an uplift to the value placed on a travel credit voucher raised against an Air Ticket Fare Brands booking. Two readings of the membership decide it: the rate at which the club tier earns points per dollar, and the qualifying points the membership's own ledger carries over the last 12 months.

## 1. The uplift

1.1 Where the traveller's club tier earns 5 points or more per dollar and the membership has counted 60000 qualifying points or more over the last 12 months, the high membership uplift is added: 5.0 percent.

1.2 Where the tier earns 4 points or more per dollar and the membership has counted 30000 qualifying points or more over the last 12 months, while either that tier earns fewer than 5 points per dollar or those points are fewer than 60000, the standard membership uplift is added: 3.0 percent.

1.3 In every other case no membership uplift is added.

## 2. What the points count is read from

Qualifying points are counted from the entries the membership's ledger carries inside that period alone, and the total shown on the membership record is not that count.

## 3. Truth table of the two readings

| Points earned per dollar by the tier | Qualifying points over the last 12 months | Uplift added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 5 or more | 60000 or more | 5.0 percent |
| 5 or more | 30000 or more but fewer than 60000 | 3.0 percent |
| 4, or more than 4 but fewer than 5 | 30000 or more | 3.0 percent |
| 4 or more | fewer than 30000 | none |
| fewer than 4 | any | none |

## 4. Worked figures, on hypothetical inputs

A figure of 600.00 USD on a membership whose tier earns 6 points per dollar and whose ledger carries 82000 qualifying points inside the window: the high uplift of 5.0 percent is added, giving 630.00 USD.

The same 600.00 USD on a membership whose tier earns 6 points per dollar but whose ledger carries 45000 qualifying points: the first condition fails on the points, the second holds, and the standard uplift of 3.0 percent is added, giving 618.00 USD.

The same 600.00 USD on a membership whose tier earns 2 points per dollar: neither condition holds, and the figure is carried at 600.00 USD.
